o.text: Internationalism; via Russian теа́тр (teátr), from French théâtre, from Latin theātrum, from Ancient Greek θέατρον (théatron).

glosses: basin (a wide bowl for washing, sometimes affixed to a wall)
match (a series of games, played until one player reaches three points, for example by winning three single games (oyuns), or a single game and a gammon (mars).)

o.text: From Arabic طَاس (ṭās), ultimately from Middle Persian tšt'. Doublet of teşt.
From Persian طاس (tâs), from Middle Persian tʾs (tās, “die, dice”).
From Ottoman Turkish زوراكی (zoraki), from Persian زور (zor). Compare Turkish zoraki.
